scope: AWR v3 adapter and weighted execution objective; TB v2 benchmark

tb_source_tree.encoding: sorted relative UTF-8 path + NUL + binary file SHA-256

checks.normalized_records: all prepared primary outputs, byproducts, inputs and costs compared to supplied Graph.prepare()
checks.query_completeness: exact target x amount x inventory x measured/warmup pass identities
checks.physical_plans: positive original recipe firings; actual stock caps; exact weighted and unweighted costs; full output balances; enabled-firing replay

run.cost: sum original Recipe.cost * original physical firings; tag cost zero
run.multi_output: full output view per anchor; sum all views by original physical recipe id

limitations: This is the supplied v3 graph, not the earlier single-output corpus. No previous AW/TB cost ratio or planning speed improvement is claimed.
Targets and named inventory amounts are preserved by verified full name sequence; leaves/random20 retain their legacy cohort labels, not fresh sampling.
Three ATM inventory rows without a verifiable old resource name were explicitly omitted; resource removal from the new graph is not asserted.
A missing or budget-exhausted planner result is not a proof of mathematical infeasibility.
AWR costs above signed int and material amounts above signed long are rejected explicitly; workstations remain registry metadata.
